question: Does CL approve choosing a browser tab’s profile only before its first navigation, then displaying that profile read-only?

artifacts.summary: A new tab without a URL opens genuinely blank in its workspace profile. A user may select a different profile there; the first committed site fixes the choice through blank-page revisits and relaunch. The design omits the optional new-tab shortcut and removes loaded-page replacement, history reset, and their tests. The new estimate is 840 net lines ±20%, with seven criteria and a two-account, two-label restart test.
